consumed_boundary.triangle_indices: Material-local surface ordinal, bounded by the material range; three unsigned LE16 corner indices, each below the material's compressed environment count before any payload read.
consumed_boundary.positions: Per corner, three LE32 binary32 bit patterns from the 32-byte compressed environment record, returned as native uint32 words (36 bytes, corner-major x,y,z).
consumed_boundary.non_finite: Exponent 0xFF (infinity, quiet or signalling NaN) rejects with CACHE_MATERIAL_VALUE at offset corner*3+axis before publication.
consumed_boundary.subnormal_and_zero_sign: Preserved bit-exact; consumers store words with integer stores into GX F32 arrays (no CPU float conversion).
consumed_boundary.alignment: Source reads are bytewise; fixtures cover two placements x eight byte offsets.
